subject: Next steps & proposed pilot pathway — Sentinel Bridge
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
To: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinelbridge.com>
Cc: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 15:12:00 -0700
Subject: Next steps & proposed pilot pathway — Sentinel Bridge

Alex — thanks again for the demo earlier. Wanted to capture the commitments we discussed and propose a concise pilot (POC) pathway so we can align on success criteria and owners. Below is a short recap and a proposed 6-week plan.

High-level recap from today's call:
- Use case: triage and summarization of incoming security alerts (SIEM > ticket enrichment).
- Primary constraint: sub-500ms median inference latency for 512-token responses in the east-us region.
- Data constraints: all traffic will be routed through your VPC peering; you requested SOC 2 evidence and audit log access.

Proposed pilot pathway (6 weeks):
Week 0 (kickoff): network & credentials exchange, baseline metrics capture. Owner: Marissa.
Weeks 1–3 (integration + validation): deploy private evaluation bundle, run sample workload, iterate prompt set. Owners: Jordan (integration), Alex (test data).
Weeks 4–5 (scale & SLO testing): run mixed traffic, validate latency and error budgets, measure token cost. Owner: Jordan.
Week 6 (acceptance): review success criteria and sign-off; capture final runbook. Owner: Alex + Redwood.

Proposed success criteria (initial):
- Latency: median 500ms or lower for 75% of requests at target concurrency.
- Quality: 85% of sampled summaries rated acceptable by your SOC analyst team (we'll provide an evaluation rubric).
- Reliability: <1% error rate over a 24h stress window.
- Security/compliance: SOC 2 evidence provided; VPC peering verified; audit logs accessible.

Attachments: POC_Checklist_v1.xlsx (detailed checkpoints), SOW_SentinelBridge_draft.pdf (draft commercial terms), Network_Requirements.docx.

Ask: can you confirm the stakeholders listed below (technical: Priya; security: Alex; procurement: TBD) and whether the proposed timeline looks feasible? If yes, we'll schedule a 45-min technical deep-dive this week to collect the test dataset and finalize the network handoff.

I'll update the HubSpot record once we have alignment: https://app.hubspot.com/contacts/1234567/deal/23456

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi
Senior Solutions Engineer — Redwood Inference
irene.choi@redwood.com
--
Attachments: POC_Checklist_v1.xlsx (application checklist), SOW_SentinelBridge_draft.pdf (commercial draft), Network_Requirements.docx (network/NAT/firewall guidance)

From: Alex Turner <alex.turner@sentinelbridge.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene.choi@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Raghavan <priya@sentinelbridge.com>
Date: Tue, 4 May 2027 16:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Next steps & proposed pilot pathway — Sentinel Bridge

Irene — really helpful recap, thanks. Priya and I reviewed the proposed path and it looks sensible. A few clarifying points and requests from our side: 

1) Success criteria: the quality target is fine but we need to narrow the rubric — can Redwood propose a 12-sample rubric (accept/needs work/incorrect) and we'll apply it to a blind set?
2) Latency: 500ms median is aggressive but doable for the smaller model variants; we need a fallback plan if throughput causes tail latency >1s (can Redwood auto-fallback to a smaller quantized model?).
3) Data handling: we require an audit log delivery cadence (daily) and an encrypted S3 bucket for logs.

Stakeholders confirmed: Priya (engineering lead) will own the network handoff; I'll own acceptance sign-off. Procurement will be looped once we lock the SOW.

We can do the 45-min technical deep-dive on Thursday 10:00am PT. Priya and one infra engineer will join. Please send an invite and a brief agenda.

Thanks — Alex
Alex Turner
Head of Infrastructure — Sentinel Bridge
alex.turner@sentinelbridge.com

Alex / Irene — thanks, counting us in for Thursday 10:00am PT. Short read on what we'll bring to the deep-dive: 

- A 12-sample rubric (we'll send as an attachment) that maps to accept/needs work/incorrect with example annotations.
- A simple fallback strategy: runtime routing policy that will drop to a 7B quantized variant when observed 95th percentile latency >850ms for more than 2 minutes; we'll document the policy and provide telemetry hooks so your infra team can opt-in.
- Network checklist: we'll walk Priya through S3 encryption keys, VPC peering flow, and Log delivery (we can push to your encrypted S3 daily).

I've attached the evaluation_rubric_v1.xlsx to this thread and updated POC_Checklist_v1.xlsx with tentative owners. Jordan will own deployment tasks; Marissa will own procurement/SOW follow-up.

Next steps I propose after the deep-dive:
- Day 0: exchange credentials and run a short connectivity test (10–30 minutes).
- Day 1–7: deploy private evaluation bundle and run 1k sample requests.
- Week 2–3: iterate prompts & measure quality.

I'll send the calendar invite now.

—Jordan
